name: RVRC Holding AB (publ)
summary: RVRC Holding AB (publ) is a Swedish company specializing in outdoor and active lifestyle apparel. Operating primarily in Sweden, its comprehensive product portfolio features core apparel items such as trousers, outerwear, and a range of insulating layers, including sweaters, mid-layers, and base layers. This is complemented by an extensive array of accessories, encompassing personal items like underwear, socks, and footwear, alongside headwear (hats, beanies), belts, gloves, collars, and neck warmers. RVRC also offers essential waterproofing and garment care solutions. All these products are retailed exclusively through their online platforms. Founded in 2013, the company maintains its headquarters in Borås, Sweden.
